mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_share (share_id, session_id, user_id, title, snapshot_json, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{shareId}, #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{snapshotJson}, NOW(), #{expiresAt})
